Looking for a Pep alternative? Pep, Pep AI and Dozify compared

Two GLP-1 trackers on the App Store are called Pep: "GLP-1 Weight Loss Tracker: Pep" by Shred Apps, and "Pep AI: GLP-1 Tracker App" by Zode Development. This page compares both with Dozify, using their own listings, and says when each Pep is the better choice. We make Dozify, so weigh that.
As of November 2026: all three listings were read on the US App Store on 6 November 2026.

Quoted cells are each developer's own words. Prices are US App Store prices and differ by country; the ranges span the in-app purchases each listing shows.
When Pep is the better pick
You use Android as well as an iPhone. Dozify is iPhone only.
You want your entries and progress photos backed up by signing in, and kept in sync across devices.
You want body measurements and progress cards you can share, or strength sessions planned around your shot day.
When Pep AI is the better pick
You use Android as well as an iPhone.
You eat out often and want to scan a restaurant menu, or you want sleep and mood next to your doses.
You plan to pay for a tracker anyway and want PDF reports included.
Where Dozify is different
Dose logging and dose reminders are free, with no time limit, without an account or a sign-in.
Your records stay on your iPhone. Dozify has no cloud; the only health data it sends is a meal photo you choose to analyse.
22 languages, including the AI meal estimate.
Reminders that work with the app closed. "I took it" on the notification records the dose.
The level curve is labelled an estimate, and for medicines taken by mouth it is not drawn at all rather than guessed.
Bringing your history

Dozify reads Shotsy, GLPzy and GlucoPal exports and any CSV file with a date column and a weight, dose or symptom column. Neither Pep listing mentions an export, so check inside the app whether you can save your data as a file. If you can get a CSV, Dozify shows how many records it found before anything is written and backs up first. If you cannot, you can start Dozify with your current medication and schedule. Are Pep and Pep AI the same app?
No. Their App Store listings name different developers: Pep is by Shred Apps, LLC and Pep AI is by Zode Development LLC. They have different websites, prices and features.

It is free to download, and dose logging and dose reminders are free with no time limit. Premium adds things like the estimated medication-level curve, AI meal estimates after the first one and the doctor report; on the US App Store it is $6.99 a month or $39.99 a year.
Is there a Dozify app for Android?
No. Dozify is iPhone only. Both Pep apps have Android versions.
Does Dozify tell me what dose to take?
No. It records the plan your prescriber gives you and never proposes one.

Dozify is a tracking tool, not a medical device. It does not recommend doses and does not provide medical advice. Pep and Pep AI are trademarks of their owners and are named here only to compare facts from their public listings; Dozify is not affiliated with either and this page is not endorsed by them.
